title: "Publications"

Research on NLP for low-resource African languages — machine translation, named entity recognition, gender bias, and explainable AI.

[Full list on Google Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=al9kLwwAAAAJ&hl=en){.scholar-link}

## 2025

::: {.pub-entry}
**[Amplify Initiative: Building A Localized Data Platform for Globalized AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.14105)**

Q. M. Rashid, E. van Liemt, T. Shih, A. Ebinama, K. Barrios Ramos, M. Maji, A. Verma, C. Kalia, J. Smith-Loud, J. Nakatumba-Nabende, R. Baguma, A. Katumba, C. Mutebi, J. Marvin, **Eric Wairagala**, M. Bruce, P. Oketta, L. Nderu, O. Obiajunwa, A. Oppong, M. Zimba, et al.

[Large Consortium]{.venue-badge .venue-large} · [PDF ↗](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.14105)

Collaborative data platform engaging 155 domain experts across five Sub-Saharan African countries to produce 8,091 annotated adversarial queries in seven languages for evaluating AI safety and cultural appropriateness in non-English contexts.
:::

## 2022

::: {.pub-entry}
**[Gender Bias Evaluation in Luganda–English Machine Translation](https://aclanthology.org/2022.amta-research.21/)**

**Eric Wairagala**, Jonathan Mukiibi, Jeremy Francis Tusubira, Claire Babirye, Joyce Nakatumba-Nabende, Andrew Katumba, Ivan Ssenkungu

[AMTA 2022]{.venue-badge .venue-amta} · [PDF ↗](https://aclanthology.org/2022.amta-research.21v2.pdf)

First study of gender bias in Luganda–English machine translation; introduces evaluation benchmarks and mitigation strategies.
:::

::: {.pub-entry}
**[A Few Thousand Translations Go A Long Way! Leveraging Pre-trained Models for African News Translation](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2205.02022.pdf)**

David I. Adelani, Jesujoba O. Alabi, Angela Fan, Julia Kreutzer, Xiaoyu Shen, Machel Reid, Dana Ruiter, ..., **Eric Wairagala**, et al.

[Large Consortium]{.venue-badge .venue-large} · [PDF ↗](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2205.02022.pdf)

Multilingual translation benchmarks spanning 15+ African languages via pre-trained model transfer.
